Librairies
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

```

Importer les données
```{r}

ind_dev <- read_excel("data/climate_data/indicateurs_pedologiques/191021_Indicators_Dev_Meta_Network - Version_utilisable.xlsx") |>
  separate("ENVIRONNEMENT / PARTENAIRE", c('ENVIRONNEMENT', 'PARTENAIRE')) |> 
  filter(`AZOTE INITIAL LABEL` == "N2") |> 
  filter(`Probe Genotype` == "Montego")

```

Regarder la météo
```{r}

INRA11_LR <- read_excel("data/climate_data/indicateurs_journaliers_par_essais/1.1.4.2.1_R2011/191118_INRA11_LR_IPC_Calcul_ok.xlsx", 
    col_names = FALSE) |> 
  mutate_all(as.character) |> 
  as.data.frame()

INRA11_LR <- INRA11_LR[-dim(INRA11_LR)[1], ]


iT <- which(INRA11_LR[1, ] == "TEMPERATURE")
iEH <- which(INRA11_LR[1, ] == "ETAT HYDRIQUE")
iR <- which(INRA11_LR[1, ] == "RAYONNEMENT")
iF <- length(INRA11_LR[1, ])
iL <- c(rep("", iT-1), rep("TEMP_", iEH - iT), rep("E.HYD_", iR - iEH), rep("RAYO_", iF - iR), "")

colnames(INRA11_LR) <- as.character(paste0(iL, as.vector(INRA11_LR[4, ])))

INRA11_LR <- INRA11_LR[-c(1:4), ]

INRA11_LR[, 3] <-  as.Date(as.numeric(unlist(INRA11_LR[, 3])), origin = "1899-12-30")

INRA11_LR <- INRA11_LR |> 
  filter(! is.na(DATE))

rownames(INRA11_LR) <- as.character(as.Date(as.numeric(unlist(INRA11_LR[, 3])), origin = "1899-12-30"))

INRA11_LR <- INRA11_LR[, -c(1:3)]


```
